'''Inside the Industry''' in ''[[The Duelist]]'' #15 (February 1997, page 84) is [[Allen Varney]]'s Game News column. Its Star Wars CCG item names [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] and [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]].<ref name="duelist15news" />

[[File:Duelist 15 page 84.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The Duelist #15, February 1997, page 84.]]

The SWCCG item sits among other licensed-game notices on the same page.

<blockquote>
'''Star Wars Customizable Card Game''' (Decipher, Norfolk, VA): The second expansion, the 162-card ''Hoth'', should be out now. It includes the first of three updated Luke Skywalkers that reflect the hero's development through the movie trilogy. In January, Parker Brothers distributes another of Decipher's introductory two-player games similar to this year's Star Wars introductory game, this time based on ''The Empire Strikes Back''. ''Dagobah'', a 162-card set based on the middle section of ''Empire'', is planned for February. Plans for a ''Shadows of the Empire'' expansion have apparently been canceled. &lt;DCustServe@decipher.com&gt;; Web: &lt;<nowiki>www.decipher.com</nowiki>&gt;
</blockquote>
